name: Financial Assistance for the Marriage of Daughters of Widows/Destitute Women belonging to the Scheduled Caste
benefit: > **Financial grant :  ₹20,000/- for the marriage of daughters.**
_eligibility_text:
1. The bride&#39;s mother must belong to a Scheduled Caste community.
   1. Financial help is available for the marriage of up to two daughters in a family.
   1. The bride must be at least 18 years old on the date of marriage.
   1. This assistance is only for the first marriage of each daughter.
   1. Your family&#39;s monthly income cannot be more than ₹2,000/-. (Verified by the Tehsildar).
   1. Applicant must have lived in Chandigarh for at least 3 years.
   1. If both the bride&#39;s parents are deceased, her legal guardian can apply for this help.
